yt.title: Counting to 1 billion takes {c_y} years #Shorts
yt.description:
1,000,000,000 seconds / 31,557,600 seconds per year = {c_y} years, counting one number per second without stopping.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: How long would it take you to count to one billion?

scenes.label: counting one number per second, nonstop
scenes.narration: At one number per second, without sleeping, it takes about {c_y_say} years.
Computers do this in seconds. That is why billions of operations feel instant to us.
